title: System Overview
description: Home: is anything broken, how much headroom is left, and where to look next.

links.title: Alert rules
links.tooltip: Grafana-managed alert rules and their state

panels.title: System status
panels.description: Sum of blocking problems: NotReady nodes, degraded workloads, pods not ready, unhealthy Argo CD apps and firing critical Prometheus alerts. Warnings do not count here; they are in the alert list below.

targets.expr: (count(kube_node_status_condition{cluster=~"$cluster",condition="Ready",status=~"false|unknown"} == 1) or vector(0)) + (count((max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) > 0) - on (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) > 0) or vector(0)) + (count((max by (cluster, namespace, pod, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster"} == 1) or max by (cluster, namespace, pod, reason) (kube_pod_init_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster",reason!="PodInitializing"} == 1) or label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Unknown|Failed"} == 1) unless on (cluster, namespace, pod) kube_pod_owner{cluster=~"$cluster",owner_kind=~"Job|Workflow"}, "reason", "$1", "phase", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{cluster=~"$cluster",condition="false"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, pod) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase="Running"}) == 1) unless on (cluster, namespace, pod) kube_pod_deletion_timestamp{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "reason", "NotReady", "", ""))) or vector(0)) + (count(argocd_app_info{health_status!="Healthy"} or argocd_app_info{sync_status!="Synced"}) or vector(0)) + (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Grafana-managed alerts in the Alerting state (critical and warning). The list below names them.

panels.title: NotReady nodes
panels.description: Nodes whose Ready condition is false or unknown. Nodes that Auto Mode is draining (karpenter.sh/disrupted taint) are included here but excluded from the alert rule.

panels.title: Degraded workloads
panels.description: Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets with fewer available replicas than desired. A rollout can show 1 briefly; a value that stays above 0 needs a look in the table below.

targets.expr: count((max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) > 0) - on (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pods not ready
panels.description: Pods that are Pending, Unknown, Failed (Job and Workflow pods excluded), waiting with an error reason, or Running but not Ready. Pods of a rollout in progress appear here briefly.

targets.expr: count((max by (cluster, namespace, pod, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster"} == 1) or max by (cluster, namespace, pod, reason) (kube_pod_init_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster",reason!="PodInitializing"} == 1) or label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Unknown|Failed"} == 1) unless on (cluster, namespace, pod) kube_pod_owner{cluster=~"$cluster",owner_kind=~"Job|Workflow"}, "reason", "$1", "phase", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{cluster=~"$cluster",condition="false"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, pod) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase="Running"}) == 1) unless on (cluster, namespace, pod) kube_pod_deletion_timestamp{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "reason", "NotReady", "", ""))) or vector(0)

panels.title: OOM kills · last 1h
panels.description: Containers that restarted in the last hour and whose last termination reason is OOMKilled. Raise the memory limit or fix the leak; see Service Status for memory/limit.

targets.expr: count((max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[1h])) > 0) and on (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"$cluster",reason="OOMKilled"} == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Argo CD apps unhealthy
panels.description: Argo CD applications that are not Healthy or not Synced. Argo CD notifications already report degraded and failed syncs to Slack; this tile shows the current count.

panels.title: Golden signals — ingress and Kubernetes API
Ingress traffic
panels.description: Requests per second through the Istio ingress gateway (reporter=source), all services.

panels.title: Ingress success
panels.description: Share of ingress requests that did not fail. Failed = 5xx or transport code 0, excluding client disconnects (DC). The error-rate alert fires below 95% (5% errors).

panels.title: Ingress p95
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration at the ingress gateway over 5 minutes, all services. Streaming and long-poll endpoints raise this value.

panels.title: API success
panels.description: Share of Kubernetes API requests that did not return 5xx. Controllers, Argo CD and kubectl all depend on it.

panels.title: API p99 latency
panels.description: p99 latency of non-streaming API requests (WATCH and CONNECT excluded).

panels.title: Targets up
panels.description: Share of Prometheus scrape targets answering. A node replacement drops it briefly; the Monitoring targets panel shows which job is missing.

panels.title: Host CPU
panels.description: Average non-idle CPU time across all nodes (node-exporter). Sustained values near 100% cause throttling and latency.

panels.title: Host memory
panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal summed across nodes. Includes kernel memory that pod working sets do not show.

panels.title: CPU requested
panels.description: CPU requests of Pending and Running pods / allocatable CPU. Auto Mode adds nodes when pods cannot be scheduled, so a high value is expected; Pending pods are the problem signal.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="cpu"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="cpu"})

panels.title: Mem requested
panels.description: Memory requests of Pending and Running pods / allocatable memory. See CPU requested for how Auto Mode uses this value.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="memory"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="memory"})

panels.title: Ready nodes
panels.description: Nodes reporting Ready. EKS Auto Mode adds and removes nodes as pod requests change, so the count changes during normal operation.

panels.title: Active pods
panels.description: Pods in Pending or Running phase.

panels.title: New nodes · 24h
panels.description: Nodes created in the last 24 hours, including nodes already removed. Auto Mode consolidation replaces nodes routinely; a sudden jump together with restarts or alerts points to node instability.

panels.title: Restarts · 1h
panels.description: Container restarts in the last hour, including init and sidecar containers. Pod replacement during a rollout is not a restart.

panels.title: Namespace availability
panels.description: Lowest available/desired ratio of the Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets in each namespace. 100% means every workload has all replicas available. Click a tile for Service Status.

targets.expr: sort(100 * min by (namespace) (clamp_max(max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) / (max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) > 0), 1)))

panels.title: Monitoring targets
panels.description: Share of targets answering per scrape job. Red means the job has no healthy target.

panels.title: Needs attention — empty tables mean nothing is wrong
Firing and pending alerts
panels.description: Grafana-managed alerts that are firing or pending, newest first. Click an alert to open the rule, its query and the linked dashboard panel.

panels.title: Degraded workloads
panels.description: Controllers with fewer available replicas than desired. Click a workload to open its detail dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) and on (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) > max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")))

max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) and on (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) > max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")))

defaults.noValue: All workloads have their desired replicas

panels.title: Pods not ready
panels.description: Pods that are waiting with an error reason, Pending, Unknown, Failed (Job/Workflow pods excluded) or Running but not Ready. Reason shows the kubelet waiting reason or phase.

targets.expr: (max by (cluster, namespace, pod, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster"} == 1) or max by (cluster, namespace, pod, reason) (kube_pod_init_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster",reason!="PodInitializing"} == 1) or label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Unknown|Failed"} == 1) unless on (cluster, namespace, pod) kube_pod_owner{cluster=~"$cluster",owner_kind=~"Job|Workflow"}, "reason", "$1", "phase", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{cluster=~"$cluster",condition="false"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, pod) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase="Running"}) == 1) unless on (cluster, namespace, pod) kube_pod_deletion_timestamp{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "reason", "NotReady", "", "")) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(node) topk by (cluster, namespace, pod) (1, max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

panels.title: Argo CD applications needing attention
panels.description: Applications that are not Healthy or not Synced, from argocd_app_info. Use the Argo CD UI to see the failing resource.

targets.expr: max by (name, health_status, sync_status, dest_namespace, autosync_enabled) (argocd_app_info{health_status!="Healthy"} or argocd_app_info{sync_status!="Synced"})

defaults.noValue: All applications are Healthy and Synced

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: One row per node. CPU and memory come from node-exporter (host view); disk is the fuller of / and /local. Ready=0 means NotReady. Open Nodes and host health for history.

targets.expr: count by (node) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1))

panels.title: Ingress traffic by service (last 5 minutes)
panels.description: Requests per second, failure rate (5xx and transport code 0, excluding client disconnects) and p95 latency per destination service, as reported by the ingress gateway. Services without recent traffic are not listed. Click a namespace to open Service Status.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (cluster, destination_service_namespace, destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster",response_code=~"0|5..",response_flags!="DC"}[5m])) / sum by (cluster, destination_service_namespace, destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, destination_service_namespace, destination_service_name, le) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="source",cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])))

defaults.noValue: No ingress traffic in the last 5 minutes

panels.title: Ingress requests by service
panels.description: Requests per second per destination service at the ingress gateway.

panels.title: Ingress error rate by service
panels.description: Failure percentage per service (5xx and transport code 0, excluding client disconnects). Only services with failures are drawn. The dashed line is the 5% alert threshold.

panels.title: Ingress latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Latency of all requests through the ingress gateway.

panels.title: CPU: used, requested, allocatable
panels.description: Cluster CPU cores. Used is container usage (cAdvisor); requested is what the scheduler reserves; allocatable is node capacity available to pods.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="cpu"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1))

panels.title: Memory: used, requested, allocatable
panels.description: Cluster memory. Used is container working set; requested is reserved by pods; allocatable is node capacity available to pods.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="memory"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1))

panels.title: Nodes by instance type
panels.description: Ready nodes grouped by instance type. Steps show Auto Mode adding, replacing or consolidating nodes.

panels.title: Container restarts by namespace
panels.description: Restarts per 10 minutes, by namespace. Bars that repeat in the same namespace usually mean a crash loop; bars across many namespaces at once point to a node problem.

panels.title: API server requests by code
panels.description: Kubernetes API request rate by HTTP code.
